log.disabled: The proactive engine is off; the event is only recorded
log.pluginInvalid: The event a plugin changed is invalid; ignored
log.verdictInvalid: The verdict a plugin changed is invalid; ignored
log.jevIncomplete: The decision model returned an incomplete triage; using the text model instead
log.toAgent: Passing it to the Proactive Agent to check and handle
log.noConclusion: The Proactive Agent gave no valid conclusion; following the triage suggestion
log.triageText: Triage done by the text model: {brief}
log.promptFailed: Couldn't send the interaction reminder; retrying next round ({name})
log.timeout: The Proactive Agent didn't finish within {limit} seconds; treating it as timed out
log.triageJev: Triage done by the decision model (Jev): {brief}
log.channelFailed: Plugin {plugin}'s notification channel failed to forward ({name})

decision.log: just record it, no need to disturb
decision.digest: can be summarized for the owner later

report.reason: One sentence on why you are or aren't notifying
report.message: The full message for the recipient, written in the persona's voice; if not notifying, a summary of what was done
report.description: Submit the conclusion for this proactive event. Call it exactly once when you're done; the task ends after the call.

taskSessionGone: The task's session is no longer valid
routineSessionGone: The schedule item's original session isn't available
ownerTimeout: Waited too long for the owner
routineDeliveryMissing: Delivery for the schedule session isn't configured
ownerHandled: The owner handled it; running again
routineOnlyScheduler: Schedule events are created by the scheduler
unfinished: (Proactive handling didn't finish, or its result was invalid)
handedToAdapter: Passed to the protocol client to notify {recipient}
loopFailed: The Loop failed, timed out, or returned no valid structured result
triageFailed: Classification failed; passing it to the Proactive Loop to check
needsOwner: A background task needs you in the private chat: {reason}
quietHours: Do Not Disturb ({quiet_start}–{quiet_end} {timezone}); the notification is delayed until {quiet_end2}
